extra_ignore_reasons.^services/sulla-files/scale/: Files scale/load-test harness (own package.json, run by hand against a scratch database); not shipped in the sulla-files image and not production code.

services/sulla-vault/src/browserEnvelope.until: Replica replaces CloudVaultSyncRunner (epic/vault-oop); then delete the file and this entry together.
